title: FIX: Castep .phonon reader
body:
Closes #1832 

The .phonon file reader contains a feature to read frequency/displacement data from multiple q-points. It appears to be untested and broken.

We should seriously consider deprecating/removing this functionality which is beyond minimal scope for ASE and available from other Python libraries [Euphonic](https://github.com/pace-neutrons/Euphonic) (mature, I am the active maintainer)  and [castep-outputs](github.com/oerc0122/castep_outputs) (alpha, I am a code reviewer). As I arguably have a vested interest in that decision I'll hold off for now...

- [X] Implement (failing) unit-test
- [x] Fix the bug

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
Thank you @ajjackson and @yuzie007!

Indeed we may want to make sure that this kind of functionality lives elsewhere.  In my opinion this belongs mostly with the "castep outputs" repo or an external ASE castep plugin wrapping it.
